reader_summary.headline: My guest this week is Fidji Simo, the CEO of Instacart.
reader_summary.overview: My guest this week is Fidji Simo, the CEO of Instacart. Fidji grew up in a small town in the South of France and was the first person in her family to graduate from high school. Since then, she has had a dazzling career with stops at France’s leading university, eBay, and Facebook.

key_points.text: Fidji spent the better part of a decade at Facebook where she led the Facebook App before joining the online grocery platform, Instacart.
We talk about Fidji’s consumer product experiences, Instacart’s role within the grocery ecosystem, and delve into her personal philosophy on leadership.
Please enjoy this wide-ranging discussion with Fidji Simo.
